summary: Rows 152-165 are the Hueco Mundo infiltration block of season 8 (152-167), which en-WP states adapts chapters 252-286 / volumes 29-32 — so the 14 target rows sit exactly inside the stored fence (151 -> 251 [250], 166 -> 283 [281]) and cover 252-280 with no fence repair needed. The block is heavily REARRANGED: Pierrot un-cross-cut Kubo's parallel threads and regrouped them by combatant, so eps 152-155 run the Ichigo/Dordoni and Rukia/Aaroniero threads forward to ch 267, eps 156-158 go BACK to ch 256 p.5 for the Uryu/Cirucci and Chad/Gantenbainne threads, and ep 159 rejoins by filling 262-265 and 267. bleach.fandom's per-episode 'chapters' fields are page-level and arithmetically complete (254, 256, 262, 263, 264, 265, 267, 269, 270, 272 each partition cleanly across their episodes), and animefillerguide's chapter column agrees on every row's chapter SET; the fandom volume pages independently reverse-map vol 29 -> eps 152-153/156-158, vol 30 -> 154-155/158-161, vol 31 -> 161-165, vol 32 -> 165-167. All 14 rows are anchored (14 anchors, ch 254 -> 280); one END regression (155 -> 156) and one START back-jump are carried by rearranged annotations. Ep 164 additionally animates the 'Tedious Everyday Tales Colorful Bleach' Part 21 omake (Kubo's V Jump side series, collected in Bleach Official Bootleg KaraBuri+) — outside the 1-479 mainline numbering, so it moves no position. No filler rows in the block; the three AFL 'mixed' rows (156/160/161) carry padding and extended flashbacks, not a distinct anime-original storyline (AFG types all 14 plain canon) — anchored on their canon share and flagged for Sean.
